subject: POC trial planning - RACI & stakeholder mapping - Clearwater Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from discovery - Clearwater Health POC

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we draft a scoped POC: 

Summary of needs:
- Evaluate Redwood Private (VPC) for PHI-sensitive inference (clinical summarization)
- Success criteria: <100ms median generate latency for typical 512-token requests, data never leaves VPC, and accuracy on 5 clinical prompts meets baseline F1 > 0.82 compared to your current system.
- Team stakeholders: Priya (Infra), Michael (App/Product), Sara (Security & Compliance), Procurement TBD

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Week 0: Kickoff, confirm access & IP allowlists, sign mutual NDA if needed.
2) Week 1-2: Private deployment provisioning + sample data ingest (anonymized).
3) Week 3: Run evaluation prompts + latency/cost baseline.
4) Week 4: Iterate on config (batching/quant) and finalize success sign-off.

Action items for you: 
- Confirm internal owner for procurement and target decision date.
- Share any required security docs (I'll attach our RACI and SOW draft).

Attachments: Redwood draft SOW + RACI template (see Drive link).

If that looks right, can we schedule a 30-min kickoff Wednesday or Thursday next week?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192
\

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@clearwaterhealth.com>, Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@clearwaterhealth.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from discovery - Clearwater Health POC

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few quick answers: 

- Procurement owner: likely Maria Gonzales in procurement, but I need to confirm timelines (I expect formal PO within 4–6 weeks after SOW sign).
- Security: Sara will own security review; I attached our standard security questionnaire (we also completed your questionnaire and attached it).
- Infra & App owners confirmed: Priya (Infra) and Michael (App).

We do need to verify that Redwood Private can be deployed into our AWS account (VPC) with customer-managed KMS — is that supported? Also want to confirm the expected infra lead from Redwood for the provisioning work.

If Wednesday 6/17 at 11am PT works for you, let’s book the kickoff then.

Thanks,
Alex
Sr. Director, Product Infrastructure
Clearwater Health

Attachments: security_questionnaire_clearwater.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearwaterhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from discovery - Clearwater Health POC

Alex — appreciate the quick turn. A couple notes from the engineering side and a proposed RACI mapping to speed approvals: 

High-level technical notes:
- Yes, Redwood Private supports deployment into a customer-managed AWS VPC with customer KMS. Aditya will be the primary infra lead for the provisioning and will request temporary IAM role/CloudFormation details during kickoff.
- Dev will coordinate with Sara on required logs and any additional audit configurations for SOC-like evidence.

Proposed RACI (draft):
- Infra provisioning: Responsible = Aditya Rao (Redwood), Accountable = Priya Singh (Clearwater), Consulted = Marissa Cole, Dev Patel; Informed = Michael Reyes
- App integration (API + keys): Responsible = Michael Reyes (Clearwater), Accountable = Michael Reyes, Consulted = Aditya Rao, Informed = Marissa Cole
- Security review & questionnaire: Responsible = Sara Patel (Clearwater), Accountable = Sara Patel, Consulted = Dev Patel (Redwood), Informed = Priya Singh
- Procurement/PO/contract sign: Responsible = Maria Gonzales (Clearwater), Accountable = Alex Johnson, Consulted = Marissa Cole, Informed = Lauren Bishop

I attached a RACI template and a short draft SOW to reflect the 4-week POC timeline Marissa outlined.

Next steps:
- Confirm kickoff time (Marissa / Alex) — we propose Wed 6/17 11am PT.
- Alex: confirm procurement owner and target PO date.
- Priya: share any VPC/KMS constraints ahead of the call.

Thanks — I’ll be on the kickoff to onboard the infra team.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_raci_template.xlsx, Clearwater_POC_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@clearwaterhealth.com>, Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@clearwaterhealth.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from discovery - Clearwater Health POC

Lauren — thanks for the RACI. Couple quick clarifying Qs before kickoff:
1) For the "Responsible" infra work, how long of an access window will Aditya need to the account (we prefer short-lived roles; can you provide exact CloudFormation templates or an operator-run path)?
2) For procurement: Maria is confirmed as procurement owner. Target PO window now looks like 3–5 weeks (team will try to accelerate).

We’d also like a short demo during kickoff that shows the VPC onboarding flow and KMS integration (10–15 minutes). Is Aditya available to demo that?

Thanks,
Alex

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from discovery - Clearwater Health POC

Alex — perfect, thanks for the confirmations. Quick responses and agreed next steps: 

1) Access & onboarding: Aditya will request a short-lived IAM role (recommended 4 hours for initial provisioning) and we’ll provide both a CloudFormation template and an operator-run option. Aditya — can you confirm availability to demo the onboarding flow at the kickoff on 6/17 11am PT?
2) Procurement: noted Maria Gonzales as procurement owner; target PO window 3–5 weeks. We’ll route SOW to Maria after kickoff and follow up on timeline.
3) Kickoff: Scheduling note — Alex initially suggested Wed 6/17 11am PT; if that still works we’ll send the calendar invite.
4) Success criteria: We’ll formalize the measurement plan in the kickoff doc: sample prompts, evaluation scripts, and baseline dataset.

Action owners assigned: 
- Aditya Rao (Redwood): Infra provisioning + VPC/KMS demo (Responsible)
- Dev Patel (Redwood): Security questionnaire follow-up & logs configuration (Consulted)
- Priya Singh (Clearwater): Provide VPC constraints & KMS policy (Accountable)
- Michael Reyes (Clearwater): App integration point and test harness (Responsible)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood): Coordinate SOW routing and procurement follow-up (Informed/Consulted)

I’ll send the kickoff invite once Alex confirms 6/17 11am PT. Thanks everyone — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa

(415) 555-0192
